sections_blueprint.name: Our History - Perjalanan Sejak 2018
sections_blueprint.headline: Kisah Batika: Menjembatani Warisan Leluhur dan Modernitas
sections_blueprint.content: Batika didirikan pada tahun 2018 di Yogyakarta dengan sebuah visi berani: memadukan keindahan kain batik adiluhung dengan tas kulit berkualitas tinggi. Kami ingin menghadirkan apresiasi tulus atas budaya Indonesia ke dalam busana sehari-hari yang memancarkan kesan elegan, anggun, dan modern tanpa kehilangan jiwa tradisinya.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace generic placeholders with the provided high-resolution Indonesian artisan & handcrafted leather bag photography.
2. Use Lora or Playfair Display for all major headings and Plus Jakarta Sans for the body copy. Do not default to Inter or standard sans for headings.
3. Keep the color palette loyal to Soga Brown (#7C4425), Deep Indigo (#121E36), Keraton Maroon (#5E1914), and warm parchment ivory (#FAF7F2).
4. Implement SVG batik pattern backgrounds (Kawung geometric circles & Parang diagonal waves) with low opacity (4-8%) to provide cultural depth without distracting from readability.
5. Every product card MUST have a 'Tanya Harga via WhatsApp' button with contextual URL-encoded WhatsApp links pointing to +6285800288414.
6. Include the interactive custom inquiry selector that dynamically updates the WhatsApp message generator so users can select category, motif preference, and leather color.
7. Implement a floating WhatsApp button at the bottom-right that stays visible on mobile and desktop.
8. Ensure every button and interactive element has unambiguous data-testid attributes according to testing specifications.
9. Use glassmorphic blur with solid undertone for the navbar: `backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FAF7F2]/90 border-b border-[#7C4425]/15`.
10. Include both Tokopedia and Shopee official store outbound links alongside social links (Instagram @batika_bag, TikTok @batikabag, Facebook BatikaBag).

accessibility_guidance.contrast_ratio: APCA and WCAG AA compliant. All body copy on ivory surfaces has at least 5.5:1 contrast.
accessibility_guidance.button_states: Hover, active, and focus-visible states must show sharp ring and color elevation.
accessibility_guidance.screen_readers: All decorative SVG batik patterns have aria-hidden='true', and all images have descriptive Indonesian alt tags.
